title: Edit your tech pack bill of materials
summary: Change a material name or photo in your BOM. We also show how to sort fabrics, trims, labels and artwork.
body_markdown:
Open the bill of materials table to change your material details. To change a photo, click the image preview and choose Replace. Choose fabric, trim, label or artwork for the category. These categories sort the reference pages in your PDF.


[Watch on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RqbZyKubZqM)


## Before you start


- Open a tech pack with a bill of materials.
- Have the material details and any replacement photos ready.


## How to do it


1.


### Edit the BOM table


Open your bill of materials and change the material details you need to update. Check the change in the PDF too.


2.


### Replace a photo


Click the material image preview, then choose Replace. Select the photo you want to use.


3.


### Check the linked images


The BOM image is linked to the artwork reference images. After you replace it, check the image in both places.


4.


### Choose the category


Choose fabric, trim, label or artwork. These categories sort your reference pages. Check the pages in the PDF after you change a category.


## An example


### Change a fabric name and photo


The example changes “Main Fabric” to “gray cotton fabric,” then replaces the photo. Use your own material name and photo, then check the linked reference page.


## Things to check


- After replacing a photo, check the BOM thumbnail and the linked reference page.
- Check the category. It decides where the reference appears in the PDF.
- Make sure the material name and photo match before you share the tech pack.


## A few common questions


How do I change a BOM photo?


Click the image preview in the BOM, choose Replace, and select your new photo.


Why does the same image appear on another page?


The BOM image is linked to the artwork reference images. That is why you can see it in both places.


What do the BOM categories do?


They sort the reference pages into fabrics, trims, labels and artwork in your PDF.


## Video transcript


Read the transcript


Click your bill of materials to see the table. In this table, you can edit your bill of materials. For example, change the name Main Fabric to gray cotton fabric. The PDF updates as well. To change the image associated with the BOM, click the preview image, then click Replace and choose an image you have on hand. The BOM image preview is linked to the artwork reference images. When you change an image, as in the fabric image replaced with Techpack Mama, it updates in two places and keeps everything synchronized. In the BOM, you can choose different categories and reassign artwork, trims, fabrics, and labels. These categories sort the artwork reference pages into fabric, trim, label, and artwork pages. That is why you can see multiple pages associated with your BOM.
